asset_role: Original exploratory art plate for J4 image-led monthly calendar study
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original editorial art plate for the top image area of an exploratory monthly calendar; art only
Primary request: Create a sophisticated abstract material-and-light photograph of translucent cobalt-blue paper layers and one pale apricot translucent sheet on a neutral light-gray ground. Carefully composed paper shapes overlap so their translucency and directional natural light form a restrained interplay of soft shadows with crisp edges. Preserve tactile fine paper grain and believable photographic material detail. Generous negative space, a calm but visually distinctive photogram / still-life feeling.
Composition: landscape, approximately 3:2; a complete editorial image usable as a calendar's top hero, with deliberate spatial balance and room for cropping.
Lighting: directional natural light, controlled soft sharp-edged cast shadows, realistic subtle translucency.
Color palette: cobalt blue, pale apricot, neutral light gray.
Constraints: one original art image, no text, no numerals, no logos, no calendar, no mockup, no frame, no artist or brand references. Do not imitate a named existing artwork. This is an exploratory art direction and does not represent a confirmed user's visual preference.
